sample_policy: all original 6080 training trials, including every author flag; no filtering by model score or physiology; former10 development and12 confirmation EEG/cache forbidden
aggregation: equal weight per person; report mean, median, sign counts and all person values; descriptive only, not classifier accuracy or a significance test
